N3 meta-compiler dispatch (no single compiler handles all types)
N6 trace standardization (no unified trace format)

non_observable_states: N5 interpretation internal state (for weight-based artifacts)

N9 registry needs conflict resolution for concurrent updates

gap_impact_on_loop.GAP-015: N1 spec incomplete for weight-space → loop only works for symbolic specs
gap_impact_on_loop.GAP-016: N8 composition not formal → composition loop is empirical only
gap_impact_on_loop.GAP-017: N7 cannot validate cross-representation → validation loop incomplete
gap_impact_on_loop.GAP-018: N5/N6 effect tracking missing → side effects untracked
gap_impact_on_loop.GAP-019: N9 registry not unified → version flow fragmented
gap_impact_on_loop.GAP-020: N1/N5 probabilistic semantics missing → stochastic functions unhandled

overall_assessment: Minimum closed loop is PARTIALLY FEASIBLE. The spec→compile→artifact→interpret→trace→validate→spec cycle can work for symbolic functions but has 3 missing interfaces and 3 non-observable states. Weight-space functions cannot complete the loop due to GAP-015 (no spec) and GAP-017 (no cross-rep validation).
prohibited_wording: Do not claim the closed loop is 'proven' or 'verified'
Do not claim all 9 nodes form a working system
